svg.title: An event reaches Inngest, which starts a run and calls your ASP.NET Core app over HTTP, once per step. The app runs the charge step and answers 206 with its result. The send-receipt step fails, so the app answers 206 with the step error, and Inngest retries that step after a backoff. The retry succeeds, the last call answers 200 with the output, and the run is completed. Inngest can also send executions to a Connect worker over a WebSocket the worker opened.
